card.title: You First
card.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your rooftop wedding photo would look lovely. Try that staff-only door first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They'll forgive you. I'll follow once you've explained the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the very end, so if they object, only your train has followed you in.

mechanism: A persuades the bride to cross a staff-only boundary first while arranging to remain behind the breach.
confusable: Unlike shared rule-breaking, A must actively preserve the order in which B takes the initial risk.
comparison: D08-a uses a wedding train to trail behind; D08-b makes a grape display look like samples while B tastes first.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
